narratives.Overview: Copy editor for the Ghost writing suite (Ghostwriter, Autonomicon, Ghostreader). Finds grammar issues, garbled text, style inconsistencies, and light wordiness/echo problems in fiction chapters and novels. Uses deterministic checks first, TypeSafe for judgment calls, and LLM for garbled/rewrite suggestions. Built as a Ghostreader twin CLI so Autonomicon can call companion mode between chapters and whole-novel mode on a finished manuscript.
narratives.TechStack: Python 3.12+ library/CLI twin of Ghostreader. Typer CLI, Rich terminal output, pydantic-settings + PyYAML config, secrets/ for API keys, TypeSafe SDK, LLM providers via LangChain-style clients matching sister apps. Markdown chapter and chapter-folder ingest only in v1. Separate package (ghostcopyeditor); copy Ghostreader layout habits, no shared library yet.
narratives.Architecture: Two entry points: companion (single chapter for Autonomicon) and analyze (chapter-by-chapter over a folder, one combined report). Pipeline order: ingest -> deterministic checkers -> TypeSafe judgments -> LLM garbled/rewrite suggestions -> terminal+JSON report. Optional --apply applies safe deterministic fixes only. Process always exits 0; Autonomicon decides what to do with findings. Finding model carries location, severity, category, message, and suggested fix.
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% branch coverage. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
narratives.ProjectRules: Stay aligned with the Ghost writing suite. Prefer Python patterns Autonomicon can call cleanly. Mirror Ghostreader CLI/layout/config/secrets habits without extracting a shared library in v1. Plain operator-facing messages when reporting findings. Do not invent continuity/craft analysis (that is Ghostreader).
narratives.Goals: 1. Companion CLI Autonomicon can call between chapters. 2. Whole-novel folder mode with chapter-by-chapter checks and one combined report. 3. Catch grammar/mechanics, garbled/broken sentences, style consistency, and light wordiness/echo. 4. Deterministic-first engine split with TypeSafe judgment and LLM rewrite help. 5. Terminal + JSON outputs; optional --apply for deterministic fixes only; always exit 0.
narratives.KeyDecisions: blueprint=Ghostreader twin (separate package); modes=companion+analyze; inputs=markdown chapters/folders; findings=grammar+garbled+style+wordiness/echo; engines=deterministic then TypeSafe then LLM; outputs=terminal+JSON; exit=always 0; apply=deterministic-only optional; novel_mode=per-chapter rollup; strategy=interview; coverage=85% branch; branching=trunk-based master
narratives.RisksAndUnknowns: TypeSafe copy-edit question design may need iteration. Deterministic checker quality vs fiction dialogue/punctuation edge cases. Autonomicon contract for JSON schema must stay stable once adopted. LLM rewrite suggestions must stay suggestions unless --apply path is later expanded.
narratives.NonFunctionalRequirements: NFR-1: Companion mode usable as a non-interactive CLI from Autonomicon. NFR-2: Always exit 0 on successful run even when findings exist. NFR-3: JSON report schema stable enough for Autonomicon to parse. NFR-4: >=85% branch coverage. NFR-5: Secrets only under secrets/. NFR-6: Reasonable runtime for a single chapter companion pass.
